### 3. The Māyic-threshold delineation — the eight determinations' mythic recapitulation (Frank-locked)

Frank's notes give the eight determinations a complete mythic recapitulation in one author, with page anchors: `−/−` En-Soph/tohubohu (pp. 18, 106); `0/1` the world parents' separation; `?/!` the coming of light; `−/+` hunger as systole/diastole; `X/x` ego against the unconscious ground; `AM/IS` "I am I" (with Frank's paśu correction — the Bṛhadāraṇyaka passage Neumann quotes at p. 105 shows recognition preceding separation: "I am" is prakāśa's vimarśa before pati/patni, and Neumann collapses prakāśa-vimarśa into ego); `∞/dx` the great round (Mono/Poly pleromatic); `1/0` the hero's descent and return. Frank's lock-gloss: this is the delineation of the Māyic threshold — the first unfolding into differentiation of the `0/1`, the `4+2` (+2) retaining its conditions of transformation and genesis as explicit qualities. Candidate grounding: Argument 13 (tattvic differential field) and Argument 20 (advent) via phylogenetic recapitulation. Open placement question, carried to harmonisation: plate/appendix object vs woven §4 prose register.

developed_occurrence.text: ## #4 Taylor's paper scene makes the return performable. Begin with a blank sheet. Write `1`. Attend to the paper on which the mark appears and write `0`; attend to the act that distinguishes and relates them and inscribe the slash. The written `0/1` is now itself a determinate figure on the sheet. It too can be taken as `1` relative to the field through which it appears. Erase it. What disappears is the inscription; the capacity for appearing, distinguishing and writing has not been cancelled by the disappearance of this form. The sheet is an image within that capacity, not the literal substance of unobjectifiable awareness. The changed reader can begin again carrying the operation just performed. **Human-amplified: yes** for this paper/mark/slash/erasure operation in Taylor's protected Neumann encounter. The scene **figures** [the Two Ones](../../../episteme/arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) and **returns-to** their concept, [0 = One, 1 = All](../../../episteme/concepts/C49-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md). `0` bears the uncounted One; `1` bears All, the whole manifest field as well as each indefinite particular within it. The contrast cannot be reduced to blank material and one isolated item. The first mark opens the possibility of a world of marks. Their plurality is real, and their common condition does not become one giant object beside them. The scene consequently **returns-to** [Mono/Poly](../../../episteme/arguments/A12-Mono-Poly-One-All-Whole-Many.md): the whole is structurally prior to its determinations, while each determination contributes a real difference to the field that returns. [The native theorem spine](../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md) **grounds** the complete movement. [Six Positions, Eight Turns](../../../matheme/ql/eight-determinations.md) **defines** the exact relation between the positional body and its bracketed traversal: `/ = −/− → 0/1 → ?/! → −/+ → X/x → AM/IS → ∞/dx → 1/0`. These are eight determinations of one relation, with parent and return bracketing six interior determinations. They are not eight Neumann stages, and they are not the six headings of this page. The authored mythemic refraction follows their distinctions rather than deriving them from an image. The undelimited `−/−` receives the encounter's unbounded and unformed fullness. The ratified recapitulation brings En-Soph at the p.18 lead and tohubohu at p.106 to this office while retaining their distinct inherited traditions. At `0/1`, world-parent genesis figures the emergence of distinct offices within one relation. At `?/!`, the opening of light becomes the availability of a determinate answer whose question remains live. What appears can be specified because the field was capable of determination before this specification. At `−/+`, hunger, intake and expenditure give polarity its bodily tension. The two directions can work through each other; abolishing their distinction would abolish the operation. At `X/x`, determining capacity receives an indefinite particular without being exhausted by it. This is **Taylor's native QL notation**. Ego and unconscious, or ego and encompassing psychic whole, supply a named psychic refraction after that relation has been derived. At `AM/IS`, recognition becomes sayable from first-person presence and third-person predication. The slash carries the relational encounter through which those sayings meet, including the second-person address that changes both speaker and what can be said. The primordial I-am and the bounded ego's identity therefore cannot be silently equated. At `∞/dx`, the inexhaustible field meets exact local determination. The great round can figure the field carried in each finite expression, while the finite expression remains exact in its own office. An image of a circle does not establish an analytic theorem. At `1/0`, the determination returns toward the condition it cannot contain. The descent and return, the transformed personality, and the erased inscription can figure this movement precisely because each leaves a difference that has been undergone. The return is no longer unconscious containment before the separation. **Human-amplified: yes** for this eightfold refraction as explicitly developed and corrected in the authored quilt; its formal universality belongs to QL, and its Neumann correspondences remain **Argued from** the source encounter. The supporting native field gives both parents a complete 4+2 in inverse orders. Essence persists while Structure and Formality exchange offices. Being at 0/1, Becoming at 2/3 and Knowing/unKnowing at 4/5 form the three harmonics; the complementary folds of Essence at 0+5, Constitution at 1+4 and Text/Texture at 2+3 have a different operation. Their coincidence at 2/3 does not make the two distributions identical. This preserves enough of the whole field to prevent a parent, a gender, or a single symbolic episode from being frozen as one slot. [The primordial Symbolon and its eight determinations](../../../episteme/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) **grounds** that complete derivation; this page returns its lived cost through nourishment, separation, conflict and changed recognition. The same cost requires both Name and Power. Truth, Mind, Word, Logos, Son and Image are accompanied by Play, Need, Sacrifice, Decision, Love and Work. The visible image arrives through something lived: a need met, an alternative relinquished, a decision carried, a relation sustained. Power includes generativity and care as well as its possible capture. The Great Mother cannot simply stand for pathology, any more than the father's authority automatically stands for truth. This whole **figures** the coequal series by following what formation costs and what its return releases. The page's result is an image capable of entering another life, answerable to the work through which it came. Taylor's toroidal correction belongs at this point of developed relation. Neumann's circular perfection remains the source image; the authored refraction gives the uroboros a hole and a traffic through which taking becomes transformation. Position can present the round as a finished circle; opposition exposes head and tail, appetite and food; superposition makes their self-eating relation active in `(0/1)/(1/0)`; interposition articulates the four explicate movements together with the implicate axis and opening, with #5 enfolding what has been traversed. The trickster's circle or sphere can conceal that operative opening. The distinction concerns what the image permits the reader to do, and does not claim that every circular drawing is topologically a torus. The independent [uroboros, circulation and trickster whole](../uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md) **tests** whether shared archetypal structure has been mistaken for a closed picture; it owns the developed drama to which this local relation returns. In that authored correction Anuttara/Paramaśiva bears the unobjectifiable opening; Māyā bears measure in manifestation. **Human-amplified: yes** for the toroidal correction, its four operations and this allocation in the ratified quilt. No claim that Neumann taught toroidal mathematics follows. [Homology and analogy](../../../episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **qualifies** the crossing: the relation must state what operation is preserved, what register changes and what evidence remains with its original source.

developed_occurrence.text: ## #2 Separation of the World Parents opens the interval in which a world can appear. Heaven is distinguishable from earth; light can enter the space between them. An undifferentiated enclosure becomes an articulated field with directions and contrasts. The ego emerges within this opening as a position able to discriminate. What appears outside it becomes nameable because the act of differentiation has also given the observer a place. The transmitted creation scene at the encounter's p.105 lead requires its own sequence. The primordial person recognises itself, then divides into the paired figure of man and woman previously held as if in an embrace. Self-recognition precedes sexual separation in this telling. The androgyne therefore performs a relational office: the two who become partners arise through differentiation of a prior togetherness. The image places sex and gender within a genesis of relation; its use here depends upon preserving the before, the embrace, the division and the changed relation afterward. The independent primary passage and its exact translation remain a source debt. Neumann's psychological reading stresses the achievement of ego identity and the discriminating consciousness that says I am I. Taylor's response separates that achievement from the more primordial self-recognition expressed in the native relation. Prakāśa–vimarśa does not first arise when an ego takes possession of an identity; the finite experiencer and its inner instrument are determinations within the field of appearing. This authored distinction **returns-to** [the tattvic differential field](../../../episteme/arguments/A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md), and **qualifies** [the bounded subject-position](../../../episteme/concepts/C15-Pasu-Bounded-Subject-Position.md) and [the inner instrument](../../../episteme/concepts/C16-Antahkarana-Inner-Instrument.md). The acquisition of a determinate I is a real formation. It cannot retrospectively produce the awareness through which the acquisition appears. **Human-amplified: yes** for this explicit correction in Taylor's encounter; the psychological and Śaiva source offices retain their own evidence requirements. Light brings more than a collection of visible objects. In the leads at pp.106–109, an oriented world appears: above and below, before and behind, inside and outside, I and you, sacred and profane, good and evil. Boundaries make a precinct, a possession, a law and an order of action possible. Some of those institutional consequences are Taylor's authored extension of the encounter, not a verified universal history derived from Neumann. Their formal pressure is exact: a measure both reveals a field and selects what will count within it. [Māyā as operative measure](../../../episteme/concepts/C14-Maya-Operative-Measure.md) **qualifies** this refraction. Differentiation is productive; its danger begins when the selected measure conceals its dependence upon a wider field. The image cannot be held to a fixed light/good and dark/bad dictionary. Light names disclosure from one position; what that position leaves unlit belongs to the same field. Father and mother, active and receptive, inner and outer likewise change office with the direction of the relation. Taylor's local p.108 appointment of night at #0, day at #5 and four directions at #1–#4 gives this encounter a 4+2 articulation: the spatially specified field is held through implicate conditions of appearance and return. **Human-amplified: yes** for that local appointment. It does not appoint every creation myth to six universal episodes or make time and space interchangeable. The gain of a world brings the wound of separation. Neumann's guilt and fall motif, encountered at pp.114–115, joins creative light to the loss of original containment. The emerging ego suffers the break it must accomplish. Its weakness and dependence do not disappear because it can name itself; the power of discrimination exposes them differently. The separation cannot simply be reversed without surrendering the differentiated life it enabled. This is why the story must pass through the hero. Something has to bear the cost of leaving while finding a relation to what has been left.

developed_occurrence.text: ## #1 The round lives by taking into itself. Mouth meets tail; eater and eaten belong to one body. Hunger prevents this body from being an inert totality. What sustains it passes through it, changes it, and is released. The digestive and generative images in Taylor's encounter with Neumann, especially the leads at pp.27–33, give the round an interior movement: intake and expenditure, fullness and need, birth and reabsorption, systole and diastole. The infant's dependence upon nourishment gives this movement its psychic intimacy. Before an independent ego can say what the mother is, its life is being sustained through her. As the Great Mother becomes the first object-face of the unconscious, the encompassing life acquires an address. What gives birth also has the power to take back; the shelter can become engulfment. The nurturing and terrible aspects belong to a relation whose terms are changing. The child needs the source from which it also needs to differentiate. Mother as life-giver and mother as devourer make this ambivalence visible without making every mother either beneficent or destructive. Neumann's archetypal office is already larger than a biographical parent, although it is encountered through the bodily dependency that makes the image compelling. The metabolic passages matter because receiving is an operation. Food becomes the body of the receiver; the receiver is altered by what it receives. The leads through Prajāpati, hunger, life and death, and the offering of the world to itself place creation within this exchange. They reach this page through Neumann and the copied encounter, including his mediation of Indian material; their primary textual and translation homes remain distinct. The page does not turn a transmitted Prajāpati passage into an independently established Upaniṣadic quotation. What the encounter makes available is the pressure of a life whose generation includes expenditure and whose survival cannot consist in indefinite retention. The p.29 encounter gives this pressure a named transmitted form: Prajāpati creates the world as an offering to himself, with horse and universe joined in the sacrificial image; the passage received through Neumann and Deussen connects *aditi* and becoming an eater of the world. Taylor takes the receiving of a world into an inquiry about how experience forms an operative interior. At p.27 he brings Bhairava and Śaiva devouring into the same inquiry: Mono–Śiva receives and assimilates Poly–Śakti forms, whose integration can issue in samāveśa. **Human-amplified: yes** for this authored assimilation relation. The *ad/aditi* linguistic account and particular Vedic or Śaiva tellings remain transmitted source leads requiring their own primary verification; they do not supply new historical findings here. The lived consequence is already precise: what is received must be capable of transforming the receiver and returning as generative capacity. Taylor's authored refraction sharpens that difference into nourishment and monopoly. The self-eating round can figure assimilation that renews life, while the Saturnine devourer can figure taking that permits no new birth. The difference lies in what the taking makes possible next. A structure that consumes its conditions while preventing their renewal interrupts the generative relation on which it lives. This is an **Argued** amplification of the bodily encounter, **human-amplified: yes** for this nourishment/non-generating consumption relation. It is not an attribution of QL political or technical claims to Neumann. The relation **qualifies** [monoisation and counter-generation](../../../episteme/concepts/C26-Monoisation-Counter-Generation.md): incorporation becomes counter-generation when the receiving centre monopolises the power of renewed emergence. The same encounter introduces centroversion, at the leads marked pp.34–35. Inner and outer movements are gathered toward the formation of a whole personality. This gives the later heroic struggle a destination beyond escape. A being exclusively serving an external collective, or exclusively possessed by an internal power, has yet to make the relation its own. The centre has to form without confusing the conditions of formation with its property. The source will reach that problem through separation and conflict; centroversion makes its return audible already within the nourishing round.

developed_occurrence.text: ## #3 The hero is born within the world opened by the separation. Neumann's sequence then carries two emancipations: the slaying of the mother, followed by the slaying of the father. The maternal struggle addresses the engulfing origin from which the hero must become distinct. The paternal struggle addresses the authority that can arrest that emergence in an inherited order. If the telling stopped after escape from the mother, the father's law could simply inherit the power of enclosure. Keeping both struggles in sequence makes emancipation answerable to the actual formation of a centre, rather than to the replacement of one captor by another. The violence belongs to the mythic and psychological telling. Its operation is differentiation from an overwhelming archetypal claim. Neumann's historically gendered morphology remains visible as his account. The page's relational reading follows the changing offices in the drama, including the earlier androgyne and the later possibility of partnership. Removing those changes would turn a developing relation into a static classification of persons. The next movement is the captive, the treasure and liberation. In the book's order this precedes the Osiris transformation. The achieved power to separate is now tested by what it releases and what becomes available through release. A captive liberated into another form of possession would leave the deeper problem intact. That last sentence states the essay's authored pressure upon the image: heroic efficacy has to be judged by the relation it makes possible, including the freedom of what it encounters. It does not invent a missing passage in Neumann's account. The Osiris division then carries the book's culminating transformation office. Death and transformation prevent the developmental movement from closing as the hero's permanent occupancy of a victorious identity. The canonical source navigation warrants this office and sequence; it does not yet warrant a detailed retelling of every Osiris episode. Detailed Osiris episodes require separately recovered primary tellings and comparative passages. Here the consequential change is that an ego strong enough to emerge must also become capable of transformation beyond its established form. Centroversion gathers the movement. The formation of a whole personality requires traffic between the centre and the powers from which it differentiated. Both engulfment and sovereign isolation obstruct that traffic. The former gives the centre away; the latter makes its achieved form the measure of the whole. The centre develops by admitting what changes it while retaining enough differentiation to respond. developed_occurrence.text: ## #1 The round lives by taking into itself. Mouth meets tail; eater and eaten belong to one body. Hunger prevents this body from being an inert totality. What sustains it passes through it, changes it, and is released. The digestive and generative images in Taylor's encounter with Neumann, especially the leads at pp.27–33, give the round an interior movement: intake and expenditure, fullness and need, birth and reabsorption, systole and diastole. The infant's dependence upon nourishment gives this movement its psychic intimacy. Before an independent ego can say what the mother is, its life is being sustained through her. As the Great Mother becomes the first object-face of the unconscious, the encompassing life acquires an address. What gives birth also has the power to take back; the shelter can become engulfment. The nurturing and terrible aspects belong to a relation whose terms are changing. The child needs the source from which it also needs to differentiate. Mother as life-giver and mother as devourer make this ambivalence visible without making every mother either beneficent or destructive. Neumann's archetypal office is already larger than a biographical parent, although it is encountered through the bodily dependency that makes the image compelling. The metabolic passages matter because receiving is an operation. Food becomes the body of the receiver; the receiver is altered by what it receives. The leads through Prajāpati, hunger, life and death, and the offering of the world to itself place creation within this exchange. They reach this page through Neumann and the copied encounter, including his mediation of Indian material; their primary textual and translation homes remain distinct. The page does not turn a transmitted Prajāpati passage into an independently established Upaniṣadic quotation. What the encounter makes available is the pressure of a life whose generation includes expenditure and whose survival cannot consist in indefinite retention. The p.29 encounter gives this pressure a named transmitted form: Prajāpati creates the world as an offering to himself, with horse and universe joined in the sacrificial image; the passage received through Neumann and Deussen connects *aditi* and becoming an eater of the world. Taylor takes the receiving of a world into an inquiry about how experience forms an operative interior. At p.27 he brings Bhairava and Śaiva devouring into the same inquiry: Mono–Śiva receives and assimilates Poly–Śakti forms, whose integration can issue in samāveśa. **Human-amplified: yes** for this authored assimilation relation. The *ad/aditi* linguistic account and particular Vedic or Śaiva tellings remain transmitted source leads requiring their own primary verification; they do not supply new historical findings here. The lived consequence is already precise: what is received must be capable of transforming the receiver and returning as generative capacity. Taylor's authored refraction sharpens that difference into nourishment and monopoly. The self-eating round can figure assimilation that renews life, while the Saturnine devourer can figure taking that permits no new birth. The difference lies in what the taking makes possible next. A structure that consumes its conditions while preventing their renewal interrupts the generative relation on which it lives. This is an **Argued** amplification of the bodily encounter, **human-amplified: yes** for this nourishment/non-generating consumption relation. It is not an attribution of QL political or technical claims to Neumann. The relation **qualifies** [monoisation and counter-generation](../../../episteme/concepts/C26-Monoisation-Counter-Generation.md): incorporation becomes counter-generation when the receiving centre monopolises the power of renewed emergence. The same encounter introduces centroversion, at the leads marked pp.34–35. Inner and outer movements are gathered toward the formation of a whole personality. This gives the later heroic struggle a destination beyond escape. A being exclusively serving an external collective, or exclusively possessed by an internal power, has yet to make the relation its own. The centre has to form without confusing the conditions of formation with its property. The source will reach that problem through separation and conflict; centroversion makes its return audible already within the nourishing round.
